title: Fix declaration parsing with partial runtime test instances
description: CI reports tests/core/test_runtime_tasks.py failures because declaration parsing now reads TactusRuntime.max_tokens, but several tests construct partial runtime instances without running __init__. Runtime context construction should tolerate those existing partial instances while preserving runtime defaults for normal construction.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Fixed by making declaration runtime context read optional model-control attributes with getattr(..., None). Verified tests/core/test_runtime_tasks.py and related runtime/model tests pass, plus Black and Ruff.
